title: Slowing to a stop
caption: The velocity falls steadily from 30 m s⁻¹ to 0 in 5.0 s, so the acceleration is the gradient, -6 m s⁻². The area under the line, 75 m, is the distance travelled while braking.
alt: Velocity–time graph falling in a straight line from 30 metres per second to zero at 5 seconds, above a constant acceleration of minus 6.
description: v falls linearly from 30 m s⁻¹ at t = 0 to 0 at t = 5 s.
Area under the v–t line: ½ × 5 × 30 = 75 m.
